title: Water found in the Osiris shaft at about 37 m

tellings.quote: >> Yes, below the Great Pyramid there is water, absolutely, yes. Because we found water in the in the Osiris shaft at minus 33 37 m, approximately.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who says he has scanned beneath the pyramids of Egypt, told podcast host Jesse Michels that there is water below the Great Pyramid at Giza. He says his team found water in the Osiris shaft, an underground shaft at Giza, at a depth of roughly 33 to 37 metres. If so, it would mean water runs beneath the pyramid area itself.
